name: SP2 Stage 3 Phase 1 — Deterministic slot creation

scenarios.name: SP2-SLOT-01 responsibility slot count matches the formula

steps.text: a control structure with <n_responsibilities> responsibilities having <cas_per_resp> control actions each
<n_coord_links> coordination links in the control structure
slots are created from the control structure
the number of responsibility slots is <expected_resp_slots>

scenarios.name: SP2-SLOT-02 coordination link slot count matches the formula

steps.text: a control structure with <n_responsibilities> responsibilities having <cas_per_resp> control actions each
<n_coord_links> coordination links in the control structure
slots are created from the control structure
the number of coordination link slots is <expected_link_slots>

scenarios.name: SP2-SLOT-03 total slot count is responsibility slots plus coordination link slots

steps.text: a control structure with <n_responsibilities> responsibilities having <cas_per_resp> control actions each
<n_coord_links> coordination links in the control structure
slots are created from the control structure
the total number of slots is <expected_total_slots>

scenarios.name: SP2-SLOT-04 each control action produces all four UCA types

steps.text: a control structure with 1 responsibility having 1 control action and 0 coordination links
slots are created from the control structure
the slots include UCA types NOT_PROVIDED, INCORRECT, WRONG_TIMING, and WRONG_DURATION

scenarios.name: SP2-SLOT-05 responsibility slot_id format is RESP-X:CA-Y:UCA_TYPE

steps.text: a control structure with responsibility RESP-1 and control action CA-1-1
slots are created from the control structure
a slot has slot_id RESP-1:CA-1-1:NOT_PROVIDED
the slot has responsibility RESP-1
the slot has coordination_link null
the slot has control_action CA-1-1

scenarios.name: SP2-SLOT-06 coordination link slot_id format is CL-X:CM-Y:UCA_TYPE

steps.text: a control structure with coordination link CL-1 and coordination mechanism CM-1
slots are created from the control structure
a slot has slot_id CL-1:CM-1:NOT_PROVIDED
the slot has responsibility null
the slot has coordination_link CL-1
the slot has control_action CM-1

scenarios.name: SP2-SLOT-07 initial slot state has is_na false and empty icas

steps.text: a control structure with 2 responsibilities having 2 control actions each and 1 coordination link
slots are created from the control structure
every slot has is_na false
every slot has an empty icas list
every slot has na_justification null

scenarios.name: SP2-SLOT-08 slot creation makes no LLM calls

steps.text: a control structure with 2 responsibilities having 2 control actions each and 1 coordination link
slots are created from the control structure
no LLM calls are made
a control structure with 2 responsibilities having 2 control actions each and 1 coordination link
slots are created from the control structure twice
both runs produce identical slot lists
a control structure with 3 responsibilities having 2 control actions each and 2 coordination links
slots are created from the control structure
all slot IDs are unique

scenarios.name: SP2-SLOT-11 responsibilities with different control action counts

steps.text: a control structure with responsibility RESP-1 having 3 control actions and responsibility RESP-2 having 1 control action and 0 coordination links
slots are created from the control structure
the number of responsibility slots is 16
12 slots have responsibility RESP-1
4 slots have responsibility RESP-2

background.text: the SP2 slot creation module is importable
